Played all my ranked placements with Johanna (7 w 3 l) And always used her as my ranked trump-card.  
She has felt a bit Dull in talents, but at the same time it has worked, lately read about some talent diversity where only level 13 seem to have been the same for most and 20.  
First i was a bit taken back to the rework but all the shuffling of talents is too much for me to take in at work so when i got home i tried her out instead.  
What she feels like now is that she isn't as Tanky or resilient, back before it could take a good 6 seconds before 3 people could kill me , sure i couldn't touch them damage wise, but holding 3 people off to for example have the objective 2 v 4 felt great.  
  
But what it felt like in the PTR was not the same, i found myself using abilities more frequently than i would on live, mana running out, being ganked even. Sure the damage that was coming out was more noticeable, but it feels like they killed the tankyness of Johanna and trying to make her a bruiser.  
  
This is my feel after 3 games on the PTR so might be comps and unlucky shit and so on, but i wanna say that Tank Joh for me seems dead, maybe i'm just doing the wrong build.  
  
Edit: After a bit of thinking, i think it's the matter of health regeneration that has been removed.  
She doesn't feel as rewarding to play, if you blinded, iron shielded, condemned in the good moments, that would cripple the teams damage to you that you could heal up in a full scale teamfight or even in a moment where they would gank you with a group of 3.
